measurement.stateSnapshot: m4aSoundMain call boundary; source pointers are omitted and command/wave reads are capped at 8 bytes (16 CGB wave bytes).
measurement.inclusion: Only VBlank entries inside the source construction epoch are distributed.

reproducibility.method: Two independently fresh mGBA probe invocations per case through tools/run-mgba-probe.py; SHA-256 is over each compact JSON packet.

sourceClassification.m4aGraph: The compiled m4aSoundMain wrapper reaches SoundMain, a linked MPlayMain player chain, CgbSound, and the runtime-copied SoundMainRAM. The receipt marks only those routines and named m4a_1.s loop heads.
sourceClassification.mplay: The first five linked MPlayMain player spans are fixed in the observed set; the sixth player span varies, as do its command-pass presence and the source state feeding its track loops.
sourceClassification.cgb: CgbSound is a separately measured variable source routine over the fixed four CgbChannel slots.
sourceClassification.directSound: SoundMainRAM buffer preparation has two observed costs; its five SoundMainRAM_ChanLoop iterations carry the remaining direct-sound envelope/mixer variation.
sourceClassification.state: The v2 inventory adds bounded command prefixes, ToneData, WaveData headers/prefixes, complete scalar track/channel control regions, linked-channel kinds, and CGB wave inputs. It deliberately omits raw pointers and unbounded data.
sourceClassification.reducer: No reducer is licensed: the complete captured m4a state key does not repeat in the observed set, and the bounded command/wave inventory is explicitly not a complete dynamic execution state.
